step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram illustrates a contact center architecture powered by Amazon Connect. Users connect to Amazon Connect, which routes calls and performs data dips using Lambda linked with Salesforce. Call events/metrics are streamed to an S3 bucket and queried using Amazon Athena. Audio recordings are stored in a separate S3 bucket and processed sequentially via Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Comprehend.

graph.name: Intuit Global Contact Center Architecture with Amazon Connect
graph.notes: Architecture shows real-time telephony routing, customer CRM data lookup, and post-call analytics/transcription pipelines.
